description: Clean beauty brand operated by Better Planet Brands LLC, selling skincare, haircare and body care through its own store at acure.com; its creator-facing ACURE Ambassadors Program runs through Shopify Collabs and rewards approved creators for sharing referral links and discount codes.

evidence.summary: ACURE's official Ambassadors Program terms (effective August 15, 2026) state Ambassadors earn 25% commission on qualifying purchases by new customers and 10% on purchases by returning customers, calculated on the order subtotal after discounts, paid through Shopify Collabs, with a 15% community discount code. No cap on earnings is stated anywhere in the terms, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The same official terms publish partnerships@acure.com as the contact for program questions and support, and set eligibility at 18+, resident in the contiguous United States, accepted through the program's application and approval process.

The terms are written for creators: Ambassadors are expected to create honest content about ACURE products, and ACURE takes a license to repost and feature Ambassador content across its digital and marketing channels — a structured creator program rather than a plain publisher link scheme.

name: ACURE

reasons.compensation: 25% on new-customer purchases (10% on returning) published in the brand's own program terms — among the highest verified rates in this round; no cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A published program contact email (partnerships@acure.com) in the official terms plus a defined application route — top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Established clean-beauty brand with a formal, dated terms document for its creator program and national brand recognition.
reasons.niche_fit: Skincare-led clean beauty with hair and body lines — squarely in the beauty/skincare UGC niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open via Shopify Collabs with an approval step; eligibility is limited to contiguous-US residents 18+.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-specific Ambassador program on Shopify Collabs with content expectations, content-usage licensing and community discount codes written into its terms.

name: Keranique

description: Small Utah brand selling handmade, made-to-order synthetic dreadlock extensions (braid-in, removable and reusable), with complete looks running $500 to $1,000+, sold through its own store and TikTok Shop.

evidence.summary: DreadFullHippie's official affiliate page and program terms state affiliates earn 15% of the order subtotal on every order tracked to their link or code, with a 15-day tracking window, monthly PayPal payouts and a $5 minimum, run on GoAffPro. No cap on earnings is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The same page is built around creators: no follower minimum ('A small, engaged following often sells better than a big one'), every application reviewed by hand by the small Utah team, content guidance for install/transformation videos, a parallel TikTok Shop creator route with refundable samples, and product gifting for active affiliates — direct evidence of a small, early-stage creator base, so saturation is marked low.

The page publishes info@dreadfullhippie.com and a phone number (801-509-0428) for affiliate questions, stressing affiliates reach 'a real person on our team', and cites 4.9 stars from more than 6,500 reviews.

name: DreadFullHippie

reasons.compensation: A published 15% rate on high-ticket orders ($500-$1,000+ complete looks) makes single sales meaningful; no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Published email and phone with a promise of a real person, plus a short application form — top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Small handmade brand, but its own page cites 4.9 stars across 6,500+ reviews and full published program terms.
reasons.niche_fit: Dreadlock extensions are a narrow but highly visual hair niche; transformation content fits beauty UGC well, though the audience is specialised.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application now with no follower minimum and hand review — among the most accessible programs in this round.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-first program: content playbooks, TikTok Shop integration, refundable filming samples and gifting for consistent creators.
